title: Uehara-san, the Delusional Girl, Is in Love for the First Time
description: Uehara-san, the school’s top student, can’t stop her naughty fantasies about plain Shimoda after a strange incident. “What if the wind blows my skirt up…?” or “What if I’m tied up with a hose!?” consume her mind. Though she knows it’s wrong, her surging libido breaks her self-control, leading her to act out her wild daydreams on a bewildered Shimoda in real life! An out-of-control, fantasy-fueled.
author: none
